Definition: to scourge, i.e. (intransitive and figurative) to be stricken with leprosy
BiblicalUsage: tsâraʻ names to scourge, i.e. to be stricken with leprosy. It appears 18 times in Scripture, including Exodus 4:6 and 2 Kings 5:27.
TheologicalSignificance: My position: tsâraʻ carries the precision of a God who says what He means.
